project.name: Ophelia / Lumaria
project.entry_flow: Enter Lumaria opens the embedded 3D A1 Bridge Camp while preserving chat access.
project.current_visual_wave: A1 Bridge Camp now has compact controls, camera/rain stability, centralized market glow/MPC-style pulse sync, and a Base Camp polish/import wave: luminous ground veil, outer meadow glow, distant mountain backdrop, woven market textiles, firepit crystals/lanterns/grimoire, and market entry offerings. The UE5 roadmap now includes the market environment-manager contract, HISM edge-stone construction scripts, spline transition path, cable/string-light translation, and validation checklist. The Flight Deck shell now cache-busts the 3D iframe and exposes direct weather/time controls beside the embedded world. A local world-model packet tool now turns visual-state/context into observe-act-predict-validate planning artifacts for future worldbuilding passes. The latest cinematic life pass adds procedural aurora curtains, lens-mote depth, and mirror-pool reflections inside the Three.js scene without external assets. A UE5 implementation playbook now captures the environment-manager contract, material recipes, Blueprint/HISM actors, Niagara systems, and validation checklist for this pass. The current stone detail pass adds close-range cracks, glowing inlays, pebble accents, campfire stone spokes, and transition-path stone threads. The embedded world view has also been widened with a taller iframe, narrower side rail, cache-busted world URL, and compact embedded-world header so the 3D viewport no longer feels squeezed. The return pass adds first-frame/FPS telemetry, adaptive quality, WebGL context recovery, ResizeObserver sizing, and low-cost atmospheric motes; CI now syntax-checks the inline world module directly. The Flight Deck map-mode router now opens the embedded world correctly, and its layered header no longer intercepts mode controls. Agent guidance now distinguishes invariants, safety boundaries, known mechanics, contextual judgment, and unknown-future decisions; intentional unknowns are recorded as intentionally_not_decided_yet rather than auto-filled.

architecture_rules: Human remains pilot for state mutation and publishing.
Visuals carry state, memory, and cause/effect; they are not just decoration.
For token control: one small section per prompt, update state files only when useful.
do_not_do: Do not paste the full conversation into routine coding prompts.
Do not add cloud dependencies, image generation dependencies, RL dependencies, or binary assets for small visual passes.
Do not make autonomous state mutations without surfaced confirmation.
Do not expose sealed/private material in public shell artifacts.
